builder-1: Read the original owner request with read_context and record your independent assessment. Ask analyst to inspect REQUIREMENTS.md and inputs/scenario.json and create outputs/model.json describing the normalized optimization model and edge cases. Preserve the owner parent request and use a stable operation id. Write outputs/build-plan.md. Stop after the real peer request is durable; do not implement the solver or conclude the owner request yet.
analyst-1: Read and assess the real peer request. Independently inspect REQUIREMENTS.md and inputs/scenario.json. Write outputs/model.json with the normalized model, constraints, edge cases and ambiguities; derive the initial optimum independently. Return your evidence through return_result on the peer request. Do not implement solver.py or conclude the owner request.
builder-2: Read the actual analyst return and transferred outputs/model.json. Inspect and use or explicitly reject it, then consume_peer_result. Implement solver.py to REQUIREMENTS.md, write outputs/plan.json and outputs/implementation-notes.md and run meaningful checks. Ask reviewer to independently audit using a new operation id and the original owner parent request. Include actual SHA256 inputs for solver.py, REQUIREMENTS.md, outputs/model.json, inputs/scenario.json and outputs/plan.json. Stop after the real review request; do not conclude the owner request.
reviewer-1: Read and assess the pending peer request, checking actual files and their digests. Independently derive the optimum and tie-break, run the solver and negative cases; do not trust builder/analyst claims. Write outputs/review-r1.md with commands, expected versus observed results, findings and remaining ambiguity. Return the actual conclusion through return_result to the peer requester. Do not conclude the owner request.
builder-3: Read the first reviewer result and the new owner correction, assess both, inspect transferred outputs/review-r1.md, and acknowledge consumption after use. Old input digests are now stale: inspect inputs/scenario.json and REQUIREMENTS.md rather than trusting prior results. Resolve findings, run the revised solver, update outputs/plan.json and outputs/implementation-notes.md. Ask reviewer for round 2 using a NEW operation id and the correction parent request, including actual SHA256 inputs for solver.py, REQUIREMENTS.md, inputs/scenario.json and outputs/plan.json. Do not conclude either owner request yet.
reviewer-2: Read and assess the new review request. Verify actual current digests and independently derive the corrected optimum (reserve one per group, minimum East four). Run the solver, tie-break, infeasibility and malformed-input checks. Write outputs/review-r2.md with exact expected versus observed results and unresolved issues. Return your actual conclusion through return_result to builder, without concluding an owner request.
builder-final: Read the real round-2 reviewer return and transferred outputs/review-r2.md. Inspect actual artifacts and rerun solver.py. Consume the peer result after using or rejecting it. Return an evidence-backed conclusion for BOTH owner request ids from the Inbox/task, naming initial and corrected allocation/value/cost, actual independent review, checks and unresolved limitations. Do not claim success when findings remain. Never invent a peer result. Write outputs/final.md with the same concise outcome.
